counterScope: The root counters describe source rows only. The current package tree has 578 inputs including the source manifest; all 577 non-self paths have provenance rows with byte counts and SHA-256 hashes over committed file bytes. .gitattributes keeps distributed text at LF across Windows checkouts and preserves committed CRLF or mixed-EOL exceptions byte-for-byte; the release packager independently checks membership and file identity.

engineeringClosure.claimBoundary: Engineering provenance covers every distributed source path and current file identity. It is not a statutory copyright opinion, contributor assignment, patent clearance, or non-infringement guarantee; no legal holder is inferred.
